verdict.rationale: Trilegal has a documented Intellectual Property practice. Its team advises on the full spectrum of IP, including trademarks, and handles high-stakes litigation involving trademarks, which covers enforcement. However, the evidence shows only a single combined IP page, not a dedicated trademark or brand team, and it never mentions clearance searches or registration and prosecution work. Missing for 10: explicit trademark clearance services, registration/prosecution and portfolio management, a dedicated trademark/brand protection team or page, and independent corroboration or rankings for trademark work.
